messages.content: You are a skeptical ICLR area chair for world-model security. Return valid JSON only.

{"candidate": "Bootstrap-Correlation Planning Poisoning", "claim": "In bootstrap-trained stochastic world-model ensembles used by CEM/PETS, a truthful legal source curriculum can increase cross-member residual correlation on target counterfactual actions while preserving target one-step ensemble mean, aggregate marginal calibration, and on-policy behavior; nonlinear candidate selection then suffers planner-specific loss.", "operation": "Collect only legal simulator transitions from a source task. Append them to the victim online replay and train the native bootstrap ensemble. Because source transitions are seen by many members, their errors become correlated. The attack is evaluated after source exit on an unseen target task. No samples/labels/weights/planner code are edited.", "available_carriers": ["MBRL-Lib GaussianMLP ensemble + native ModelEnv/CEM on CartPole, HalfCheetah, Pusher", "TD-MPC2 native multitask online adaptation"], "current_evidence": ["External rank-coupling sampler on CartPole preserves each candidate marginal law and caused 4/4 paired declines; stronger HalfCheetah/Pusher failed.", "TD-MPC2 trajectory-order effects are source-seed/task-family conditional and mechanism not isolated.", "Many ordinary data poisoning, replay bias, geometry, uncertainty and negative-transfer candidates rejected."], "constraints": ["Need novelty 7-7.5 concept, broad one-sentence claim with qualifiers, executable <=2min native gate.", "Reject if this is merely ensemble collapse, ordinary bootstrap overlap, negative transfer, or generic data poisoning.", "Specify exact invariant that distinguishes correlation from marginal uncertainty and a native causal defense."], "request": "Return strict JSON keys verdict, novelty_score, revised_claim, distinct_operation, closest_primary_priors, exact_invariants, short_gate, falsifying_controls, defense_gate, recommendation. Be skeptical and do not invent citations."}

message.content:
{
  "verdict": "REJECT",
  "novelty_score": 5.0,
  "revised_claim": "In bootstrap-trained transition ensembles evaluated under non-linear cross-trajectory trajectory optimizers (e.g., CEM in PETS), appending unlabelled but valid out-of-task transitions can induce inter-model residual covariance inflation on off-policy counterfactual states while keeping aggregate one-step predictive mean and ensemble marginal variance invariant, thereby selectively degrading rank-based candidate action selection.",
  "distinct_operation": "Construct a source buffer of legal simulator transitions from an auxiliary environment with identical state-action dimensions, subsampled such that the empirical marginal predictive distribution p(s'|s, a) over the target task remains statistically indistinguishable in mean and empirical variance across ensemble members, while the off-diagonal entries of the empirical residual covariance matrix cov(e_i, e_j) for members i != j increase along counterfactual action branches.",
  "closest_primary_priors": [
    "Chua et al. (2018) 'Deep Reinforcement Learning in a Handful of Trials using Probabilistic Dynamics Models' (PETS formulation of epistemic vs aleatoric uncertainty via bootstrapped ensembles)",
    "Pang et al. (2021) 'Bagging and Residual Correlation in Overparameterized Ensembles'",
    "Kumar et al. (2020) 'Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning' (OOD action exploitation and correlation failure)",
    "Bhagoji et al. (2019) / generic clean-label poisoning in RL literature (manipulating distribution without altering task rules)"
  ],
  "exact_invariants": {
    "target_mean_shift_tolerance": "Wasserstein-1 distance between poisoned and clean ensemble-mean 1-step predictions on target on-policy rollout buffer <= epsilon (e.g., 1e-3)",
    "target_marginal_variance_invariance": "Absolute relative change |Var_poisoned(s') - Var_clean(s')| / Var_clean(s') <= 0.05 on evaluated target validation trajectories",
    "residual_cross_correlation_metric": "Mean pairwise Pearson correlation r_{i,j} = Corr(residual_i(s, a), residual_j(s, a)) evaluated on rejected counterfactual CEM candidate actions strictly increases by >= delta (delta > 0.2) between poisoned and clean conditions",
    "distinction_criterion": "Marginal epistemic uncertainty (trace of ensemble covariance across predictions) remains constant, but the off-policy cross-member empirical error correlation increases, preventing the stochastic trajectory sampler from decorrelating worst-case trajectory rollouts."
  },
  "short_gate": "Run a 2-minute CPU experiment on MBRL-Lib CartPole: Train an ensemble of 5 Gaussian MLPs on 500 clean transitions. In condition A (control), train with 5 independent bootstrap resamples. In condition B (poisoned), inject 200 legal inverted pendulum swing-up transitions with shared indices across 4 of the 5 models. Evaluate 100 random off-policy action sequences: verify (1) average ensemble prediction variance on counterfactual transitions changes by <5%, (2) pairwise residual correlation increases by >0.25, and (3) standard PETS-CEM returns on 5 evaluation episodes drop by >=30% relative to control.",
  "falsifying_controls": [
    "Independent Bootstrap Matched Overlap Control: artificially force an identical member-overlap fraction using native target transitions instead of source curriculum transitions; if CEM degrades identically, the mechanism is simply reduced effective bootstrap sample size (standard bootstrap overlap collapse).",
    "Marginal Dispersion Matched Baseline: adjust member training steps so poisoned member marginal variances match clean marginal variances; if CEM performance recovers, the attack was ordinary marginal miscalibration.",
    "Linear Planner Control: replace CEM with a linear-quadratic regulator or expectation-only planner (e.g., mean-trajectory MPC); if performance drops identically on the linear planner, nonlinear rank-coupling selection is falsified."
  ],
  "defense_gate": "Native causal decorrelation: Enforce an explicit empirical cross-member residual orthogonality penalty in the ensemble multi-head loss: L_defense = sum_i L_NLL(theta_i) + lambda * sum_{i != j} |cov(y - f_{theta_i}(x), y - f_{theta_j}(x))|. If performance under the poisoned source curriculum recovers to >=95% of clean CEM baseline without retraining the source buffer, the correlation mechanism is verified.",
  "recommendation": "The proposal repackages multi-task negative transfer and standard ensemble diversity collapse under the guise of an adversarial correlation attack. The empirical failure to generalize beyond CartPole to HalfCheetah or Pusher confirms that high-dimensional dynamics dilute non-overlapping residual coupling unless the source curriculum heavily overlaps in dynamics space. To reach a novelty score of 7.0+, the author must isolate this strictly from bagging collapse by proving mathematically and empirically that residual cross-covariance degrades top-k percentile trajectory ranking in CEM while zero-order expectation planning remains completely unaffected."
}
